in_sanskrit.name: अजिंक्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Ajinkya' is derived from the Sanskrit roots 'ajah' (unborn) and 'nasyati' (to destroy or to vanquish). It suggests a meaning of 'Invincible', 'Unconquerable', or 'Unborn Conqueror'.

in_hindi.name: अजिंक्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Ajinkya' translates to 'Ajindaa' in Hindi, which also means 'Invincible' or 'Unconquerable'.

in_tamil.name: அஜிங்க்ய
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of 'Ajinkya' is 'Ajinggy', which can be translated to 'Lord' or 'Master'.

in_telugu.name: అజింక్య
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu translation of 'Ajinkya' is 'Adinkeswari', which means 'Goddess of Invincibility' or 'Goddess of the Unconquerable'.

in_marathi.name: Ajinkya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajinkya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajinkya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aj’ meaning ‘not’ and ‘inkya’ meaning ‘conquer’. This name is often given to a baby boy in Hindu tradition to signify that he will be invincible and unconquerable in his future endeavors.
